propositions: The test harness monkeypatch stub observed_upsert has drifted from the real CriterionBank.upsert signature and does not accept evidence_sufficient and seeded kwargs that production now passes
When the completion verifier follows the bounded-fallback path (record_insufficient), it calls upsert with evidence_sufficient=False, causing the narrow test stub to raise TypeError

The bedrock LLM arm triggers the bounded-fallback recovery path due to insufficient evidence, exposing the signature mismatch; anthropic and openai arms achieved sufficient evidence and never hit the fallback
The test stub must forward all kwargs through to the real upsert via **kwargs to preserve evidence_sufficient and seeded signals and maintain parity with production
A shared test helper tests/_bank_observer.py::make_observed_upsert must extract and generalize the observation stub so unit and live tests both stay signature-faithful
